description: Boundary-condition reference topics for 3DEC — mechanical face tractions, gridpoint & rigid-block fixity, fluid flow, thermal/dynamic, and shared apply modifiers. Commands use the 'block ...' family (block face apply / block gridpoint apply / block fix / block apply).

items.name: gridpoint-and-block-fixity
items.full_name: Gridpoint and Rigid-Block Fixity / Prescribed Motion

notes: 3DEC 7.00 Release 161 (2026-08-21): 'block face apply' and 'block gridpoint apply' keyword enumerations were captured live on 7.0 and are context-free supersets matching the 9.7 sets (thermal/fluid keywords visible unconfigured; bogus tokens swallowed, only '?' enumerates — blended with the family subcommands in 7.0). apply-remove adds velocity-normal (face) and reaction-normal/velocity (gridpoint). Doc-only mass-z/origin on face apply are absent from the live 7.0 enumeration (likely doc ghosts, matching the 9.x origin verdict).
